post.caption:
A memory is not a file. It is physical structure: neurons that fire together grow more contact points, and repetition thickens that pathway like a track worn across grass. Most of the building happens during consolidation while you sleep, not while you study. Which is exactly why cramming loses to spaced repetition. Cramming loads the input and skips the construction. Spacing lets the structure set between sessions.
